recipes.name: Catgirl Qwen (brief female steering)
recipes.description: Four native MLP neurons produce a selected catgirl self-introduction in Qwen3.5-4B. Custom timing is essential: L22N8295 steers the full prompt and first 16 answer-prediction positions only; the other three coordinates stay active throughout. Manual composition of published ingredients. Ordinary tasks and conversation remain brittle. Requires the linked custom runner; applying all four constantly does not reproduce this protocol.
